issue.title: Telegram /bead is read-only, so a task bead cannot be snoozed from Telegram except through a gate button
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-gn.8 (epic sase-gn) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Not caused by the epic: /bead was already read-only; the epic added a bead mutation (snooze) that a user would plausibly want to reach from their phone.

The Telegram /bead command surface exposes show and list only, so 'sase bead snooze' has no Telegram path. sase-gn.8 verified the gate route does work -- gate_flow gates on adapter.branch_actionable, which is True for bead_snooze, with no per-kind allowlist, and bead_show_to_markdown renders a snoozed bead's [SNOOZED] marker and SNOOZE block intact -- so today the only way to snooze from Telegram is to answer a TaskTriage or BeadSnooze gate button that happens to already be pending. There is no way to snooze a bead on demand.

Scope: decide between adding a write path to Telegram /bead (at minimum snooze/cancel-snooze, and whether other mutations follow) and documenting the gate-only route as intentional; then implement the decision. If a write path is added, settle how it authenticates and how it reports failures, since every other /bead subcommand is currently side-effect free. Lands in the sase-telegram linked repo (open it with /sase_repo).
